AntiPattern.WhyBad: Reserved agent-authorship tag missing (`AX_SB_USE_AI_GENERATED_TAG`). Human curators can no longer batch-audit machine output or distinguish it from hand-curated stories; the tag's purpose is to make agent provenance discoverable.
AntiPattern.Good: `tags: ['autodocs', 'ai-generated']`. Composition with other tags is fine; omission of `'ai-generated'` from agent-authored stories is not.
